items.title: Show HN: I posted a read-later-to-paper app here in 2020. Here's what happened
items.en_title: Screenbreak: Print Any Article as a Magazine Page
items.en_oneliner: Paste an article link and get it laid out as a broadsheet, magazine or book page — no menus, ads or pop-ups — ready to print and read on paper.

items.title: Show HN: Domainyze – Track domain expiry, drops, SSL and DNS changes
items.en_title: Domainyze: Free Domain Expiry, WHOIS, DNS and SSL Checks
items.en_oneliner: Check if a domain is available and when it expires, run WHOIS and DNS lookups, test SSL certificates, and build SPF and DMARC records — no signup needed.

items.title: Show HN: CiteSieve – Check how ChatGPT and Perplexity cite your brand
items.en_title: CiteSieve: See How ChatGPT and Perplexity Cite Your Brand
items.en_oneliner: Asks ChatGPT, Gemini and four more AI engines every day which brands they name and cite, so you can track how your brand shows up in AI answers.

items.title: Show HN: AutoCaptions – animated word-by-word captions for short videos
items.en_title: AutoCaptions: Animated Word-by-Word Captions for Short Videos
items.en_oneliner: Auto-generates word-by-word, karaoke and emoji captions for TikTok, Reels and Shorts in one click, on the web or inside Premiere Pro and After Effects.
